Front view of the dog with nine coloured pivot dots, dashed leader lines and their printed names inside the box: Head pivot (keep mostly rigid), Left and Right ear pivot (swing softly), Tail pivot (small wag arc), Tag pivot (lag slightly), Left and Right front leg pivot and Left and Right back leg pivot (simple hinge). Left and right are as seen on the sheet (the left ear and left leg pivots are on the sheet's left). Section title 'Skeleton / Pivot guide' and its subtitle are sheet labels.

The numbered layer list from 12 (Tail, back) to 1 (Facial features, front), with a dashed divider between 6 and 5. Section title 'Draw order / Layer stack (front view)' and its subtitle are sheet labels.

panels.label: Assembled (front view)
panels.note: All parts assembled in the draw order, sitting front view, with its ground shadow.

The five numbered animation rules: Keep head and body mostly rigid; Ears swing softly; Tag lags slightly; Tail has a small wag arc; Keep motions simple and cute. Section title 'Animation rules' and its subtitle are sheet labels.
The Do column: its green 'Do' header pill with a tick sits at the top inside the box, then five ticked rules, each with a small thumbnail of the dog to its right (inside the box).

The Avoid column: its red 'Avoid' header pill with a cross sits at the top inside the box, then five crossed rules, each with a small thumbnail of an off-model dog to its right (inside the box); those thumbnails show what not to draw.

The whole General notes card: its heading 'GENERAL NOTES (for developers / animators)' and seven bullets in two columns. Text: Keep the same design and simple shapes as the reference. / Side view is easiest for motion and most animations. / Keep paws as simple stubs (no individual toes). / Use small squash/stretch only (stay cute and consistent). / Keep forms clean and readable. / Maintain the same proportions, colors and expressions. / Use simple arcs for motion. Avoid complex details.
